label: Ancient Mirejaw first encounter

purpose.value: Before the spawning pools, the peaceful but fiercely protective marsh guardian surfaces to issue the law's fair warning to the armed trespasser; the hero hears every word and misreads territorial care as ambush. The guardian attempts communication first; the hero misreads it as a villain's taunt.

emotionalProgression.note: The guardian announces itself and its duty plainly, framed by the spawning pools.
The warning was honest and complete; being ignored reads as insult.

notes: The scene MUST establish the guardian announcing itself and warning honestly — the law of fair warning means its attack paths will be shown, not hidden. The mercy exit (withdraw) is offered and never taken. Flavor: the spawning pools. The player's view may hint the guardian's true role; the hero must not perceive it.
